references.text: The same context in Deuteronomy about walking in all the ways the Lord has commanded, so that it may go well with you
An exhortation to fear the Lord and keep His commands all days, so that it may go well with you and your children
The call to fear the Lord, walk in His ways, love Him, and keep His commands for your own good
God's desire that His people would have wisdom to understand and consider their future
God's wish that His people would listen to Him and walk in His ways
The promise that God will give the people one heart and one way, so they may fear Him all days, for their own good and that of their children
The prophecy that God will give them one heart and put a new spirit within them, a heart of flesh instead of stone
The promise of a new heart and a new spirit, and that God's Spirit will cause them to follow His laws
The promise of the new covenant that God will put His laws in their minds and write them on their hearts
